default_run: plays once and holds recovery unless --loop is passed

phase_metrics.phase: Actuator effort / thermal or current change

phases: Actuator effort / thermal or current change

visible_behavior.Harmless small jitter: small change rises, medium and large remain low, no incident
visible_behavior.Incident candidate: robot-r2 becomes investigate or incident_candidate with bounded replay window
visible_behavior.Normal navigation: overview normal, source agreement low, tracking stable
visible_behavior.Perception/source degradation: lidar disagreement and freshness age rise
visible_behavior.Recovery or incomplete recovery: scores fall; recovery state confirms or flags residual
visible_behavior.Tracking deviation or control oscillatio: commanded velocity remains steady while actual velocity diverges
